title: [Epic line 2] MCP build: the open draft door, and the checks and probes its verdict rests on
body:
epic:#34659#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnXJdSZifpEN5i7aU

Filing gate: ④ a coordination node under the cross-lane parent #34659 (the 「MCP 二期与问数」 epic), filed on the maintainer's word in this session's chat, 2026-11-18, verbatim: 「现在就改结构」. The lines are the maintainer's: 「我们有代码搭建，mcp搭建，云端搭建，，mcp问数，云端问数」; so is their order: 「代码搭建已经可用，只是优化，mcp问数优先，其次是mcp搭建」; and the cloud lines are linked, not held here: 「云端子专题和卡片开在云项目，你只是链接，而且暂时不启动」. A parent may hold 100 children; #34659 had 72 after two days, which is why it is split.

## What this line is

A person's own AI client authors app metadata on a self-hosted runtime through MCP: it saves drafts, reads what a publish would refuse, and a person publishes in Studio. This line is the door, and everything that makes its verdict worth trusting.

**Order: second**, after line 1. Cards already in a dev's hands are finished; no further card of this line is dispatched ahead of a queued line 1 card.

## What belongs here

- The draft door, its version statement and restriction profile, the thin build skill, the build-over-the-door eval mode.
- Publish-time checks for metadata that saves and does not work (two batches), the build probes, what a refused change names.
- What an MCP client needs from the published skills: descriptions that trigger on the task, a JSON form in the served sections, a way to install the skills.

## Acceptance reading

The build-over-the-draft-door mode (#34780), which does not exist yet.

## Not here

The hosted build door and the in-product builder: the hosted line, linked from #34659.
